verdict.rationale: Clara's marketing pages claim in-product AI insights through Clara Intelligence: real-time insights that analyze all company spend, an AI 'Financial Analyst' that surfaces budget insights before issues escalate, and an automated CFO agent with predictive insights. These are only high-level marketing statements, with no documentation of how the insights or suggestions are generated, shown, or acted on. The Clara MCP is an external-assistant integration rather than in-product insight, so it is not credited here. Missing for 10: detailed product documentation of insight and suggestion features, examples of the actual suggestions produced, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
